lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Al2Ag8 (reduced formula Ba4AlAg4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Al and Ba centers each have 16 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Ag and Ba 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ag 12-vertex polyhedra and Ba 16-vertex polyhedra.
